reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: § 12.3 affirmatively states that nothing restricts Customer from hiring any person who responds to general recruitment and that Customer has made no no-hire commitment, matching the rule's preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer).
No redline or counterparty comment was proposed, which is correct for a compliant finding; the rendered text is unchanged from the original paragraph.

The failed deterministic checks (duration ≤ 12 months, general-solicitation carve-out) are artifacts of a presence rule being evaluated where no non-solicit covenant exists; they do not indicate a defect here, and the general-recruitment freedom language in § 12.3 in fact functions as the carve-out.
